name: AlienVault OTX
summary: Looks up selected indicators in AlienVault OTX: the threat reports ("pulses") that name them, and passive DNS history. Requires a free OTX API key.
description:
Keyless sources answer what an indicator is; OTX answers who has written about it and what they said it was part of, so a bare indicator arrives tied to a named report. Passive DNS dates each resolution, separating infrastructure a subject still uses from infrastructure abandoned before the events under investigation.

**Needs:** a free OTX API key. It returns the same pulse data as anonymous access, but OTX cuts anonymous callers off after a handful of requests and refuses anonymous passive DNS outright.

**Who sees it:** only OTX, which receives each indicator looked up and the analyst's API key. The indicators themselves are never contacted.

**Read results with care:**
- Pulses are community-published reports; each Campaign keeps its pulse's address in `otx_pulse_url`, so the claim can be read at its source.
- Besides scratch pulses and bulk feed dumps, the filter drops a genuine pulse that is only a name and a list of IOCs; the run states how many each rule removed.
- A lookup refused by the rate limit is reported as rate-limited, never as "nothing known", so it can be run again.

**Data and licences:** OTX pulses and passive DNS; this repository does not restate the OTX terms of use. The pack includes tldts and tldts-core (MIT, https://github.com/remusao/tldts), which embed the Public Suffix List (MPL-2.0, https://publicsuffix.org/); notices are in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

**Source:** https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/pluginpack-otx (Apache-2.0)

plugins.name: OTX Pulses
plugins.description: Fetches the AlienVault OTX pulses that name each selected IP Address, Domain, URL, File Hash or Vulnerability (CVE) and adds each as a Campaign node linked by "reported in"; its ATT&CK techniques and malware families become Attack Pattern and Malware nodes ("uses"), its adversary a Threat Actor ("attributed to"). Skips pulses without a description or with more than max_pulse_indicators (default 1000) indicators. Requires a free OTX API key.

max_pulse_indicators.title: Max indicators per pulse
max_pulse_indicators.description: Pulses with more indicators than this are skipped. Default 1000.

network.purpose: Fetch the OTX pulses that reference each selected indicator.

plugins.name: OTX Passive DNS
plugins.description: Reads OTX passive DNS for each selected Domain or IP Address. A domain gets the subdomains in its records as Domain nodes ("subdomain"), and each name gets the IP Address nodes it resolved to ("resolved to") and its CNAME targets as Domain nodes ("aliased to"); an IP gets the Domain nodes that resolved to it. Edge labels carry the first/last-seen dates; the newest max_records (default 50) A, AAAA and CNAME records are taken per indicator. Requires a free OTX API key.

max_records.title: Max records per indicator
max_records.description: Maximum A, AAAA and CNAME records taken per selected Domain or IP address, newest first. Default 50.

network.purpose: Read the passive DNS history of each selected Domain or IP address.
